text:
This looks like a small side salad on a large square plate of roughly 26 cm. The greens are mixed lettuce, spinach and radicchio, and there is a mandarin segment. The pile covers about 8x8 cm and is loosely packed, so I estimate about 40 g of greens and about 20 g for the mandarin segment, for a total of about 60 g. Greens run about 20 kcal per 100 g, and the mandarin adds about 10 kcal. A light dressing might add around 30 kcal. That brings the total to roughly 50 kcal.
